title: Chapter 149: Five Thousand Strong Enemies
content:
Chapter 149: Five Thousand Strong Enemies

Daxia led the human army and the elite troops of the alliance to withdraw outside the city, while the Zerg army was seizing the time to launch a more fierce attack on the evil god army!

Now, every time an enemy is eliminated, an enemy variable can be reduced, some system resources can be increased, and the chance of winning can be increased.

The hydralisks that entered the city have rushed to the forefront of the battle, using splash decomposition attacks and spike attacks to quickly annihilate enemies in the streets and open positions.

The Zerg puppies drilled into every building, relying on the number and the advantages of the combat environment they possessed, and quickly wiped out the enemies inside.

The battle line in the city quickly advanced to the vicinity of the central square of the city, and nearly half of the city had been occupied by the Zerg!

The enemy defenders in the other half of the city were transferred to the central front line of the city to organize defense. This half of the city was considered an empty city. As long as these enemies in front of them were eliminated, the Zerg could capture the entire city.

The total strength of the evil god army in this city is about 300,000. Excluding the troops gathered in the square to participate in the evil god sacrifice ceremony, the participating army has only more than 200,000 troops.

Up to now, the army that can continue to fight the Zerg has less than 100,000 soldiers!

For the Zerg who have experienced the underground territory war, with less than 100,000 enemies, they can win the battle with a little more effort!

However, there is a premise, you have to ignore the mysterious square not far from the front line, which seems to be no longer in this world!

"Something is coming out!"

The Queen of the Worm suddenly said to Wu Qing.

The Queen of the Worm has been monitoring the situation in the square in all directions through the one-star host. As soon as there is any movement, it will find it.

"Look at what this evil god has brought out!"

Wu Qing also observed the situation in the square through the one-star host.

The Zerg army continued to fight. When the situation in the square was unclear, their goal was to kill as many enemies as possible. Every second of them was precious!

...

In the square in the center of the city, after a strange energy fluctuation, an army of evil gods appeared!

This is an evil god army composed of 3,000 elite bear goblin infantry and 2,000 long-armed ogre throwers. These 5,000 evil god army soldiers seem to have not changed much, but their overall momentum has become stronger.

"Queen of the Worm, can you see anything?"

"Their strength has increased. This is not just a normal blessing of faith!"

"Is it the evil god who personally blessed the enhanced state?"

"You have to try it to know."

The level of strength in this world cannot only be seen from the strength of mental strength, physical strength and physical energy, but also from luck. The mysterious luck can hide many things.

Under normal circumstances, it is difficult to accurately judge the strength of others. For example, the strength of Wu Qing's insect man substitute is only one star, so no one can see it.

As soon as this evil god army appeared outside the square, the 2,000 long-armed ogres threw javelins at the Zerg attacking forces in the distance.

Two thousand javelins whizzed in at a very fast speed, and the range was already comparable to that of the Zerg Hydralisk!

The Zerg Hydralisks that attacked forward dodged immediately, but some of them still failed to dodge the attack of the javelin, and their bodies more than three meters high were nailed to the ground directly!

"What's going on?"

Wu Qing felt that these javelin were a little abnormal. Ordinary javelin could not penetrate the defense of the hydralisk and nail them to the ground!

"It seems that there is an energy attached to the javelin, and it is that energy that is working!"

The Queen of Zerg has a subtle control over the Zerg, and it knows the situation of every spore.

The Zerg Hydralisks launched a counterattack against the five thousand enemies blessed by the evil god, spraying a large amount of Zerg biological decomposition liquid and powerful spikes, but these invincible attacks were frustrated by this evil god army!

The Zerg Hydralisks' attacks were almost ineffective. The five thousand evil god troops were protected by an energy, which made the various attacks of the Zerg Hydralisks lose their due effect.

Five thousand evil god troops charged the Zerg, and two thousand long-armed ogres were professional throwers. They threw javelins while running, focusing on attacking the Zerg Hydralisk area.

The Zerg Hydralisk suffered the heaviest loss since its birth here!

"Let the Hydralisk retreat first and avoid this army!"

"Use the puppies to entangle them and destroy those normal evil god troops as soon as possible!"

Wu Qing, who had experienced countless battles, was not panicked when encountering things, and calmly gave orders to the queen.

On the battlefield, the Zerg Hydralisk near the terrifying evil god army quickly evacuated. They did not withdraw from the battle, but launched a more fierce attack on the ordinary evil god army in other directions.

The Zerg puppies did not rush up to die, but first rushed into the ordinary evil god army to fight, or drilled into various buildings to temporarily avoid the sharp edge of the strong enemy.

They would only rush up to fight if they really couldn't avoid it.

The strength of this army blessed by the evil god has been terribly improved. Almost all the Zerg puppies that rushed forward were knocked to the ground one by one by the maces in the hands of the bear goblin infantry!

The difference in individual strength is too obvious!

"The strength of these evil god troops is at least one star!"

This gave Wu Qing some understanding of the strength of this army.

Faced with this situation, Wu Qing did not adopt any special tactics to deal with it, and let this powerful army chase the Zerg army everywhere.

The Zerg army focused on destroying the ordinary army of the evil god.

At the end of the fight, there was finally a commander of the evil god who was a little more sane. He gathered the remaining remnants and withdrew to the vicinity of the city center square.

This area was relatively safer because the 5,000 strong army was chasing the Zerg puppies.

In the entire city, except for the central area of the city, there was no trace of the evil god army in other places. The Zerg puppies responsible for reconnaissance began to explore the entire city.

The Zerg host also entered the safe area of the city and conducted a more detailed exploration of the city.

There was only the 5,000 evil god army that was rushing around, and the Zerg had no way to confront it head-on for the time being.

"There are so many evil god troops in the square. If they are all strengthened like this, this battle will be over!"

"We must first concentrate our strength to kill the army outside!"

The Zerg army began to deploy against the 5,000 evil god troops.

The mysterious square sent out 5,000 evil god troops at once, instead of more, which must have been affected by objective factors.

The Zerg must seize this opportunity to kill this batch of evil god troops first.

The original foundation of this army was just an ordinary elite force. Even if it was blessed by the evil god himself, it would not be possible to become invincible. If the evil god really had this ability, this world would have been ruled by the evil god long ago.

This kind of blessing obtained through sacrifice must have weaknesses.

What this weakness is cannot be seen for the time being, but as long as a hard battle is fought, it will soon be clear whether it is real gold.
